title: LOCAL CPU CRUSH + SOUNDBOARD SUBLAYERS. Reweave everything tight. Inject into GPU turbocharger. Local soundboard per entity — hear the club next door but mix YOUR room. Decibel meter triangulation. Chipmunk and artisan must BUILD during conversations.

the_directive.start: using CPU cycles to CRUSH and REWEAVE existing material tighter
the_directive.inject: the crushed material into ludoSpring's GPU turbocharger for subfusion
the_directive.result: partial break ? X-ray/gamma visibility ? see deeper structure

manifest_optimization.current: 985 JSON entries with partial metadata. regenerated manually each gen.
manifest_optimization.crush: extract ALL titles, types, gens, waves, cross-references from every file. build a complete index.
manifest_optimization.output: a DENSE manifest that any search can use instantly

cross_reference_map.current: files reference each other by filename in text. no structured link graph.
cross_reference_map.crush: scan all 985 files for references to other filenames. build adjacency list. the BRAID made explicit.
cross_reference_map.output: a connections.json that maps every file ? every file it references

type_census.current: ~60 different type tags across 985 files. no standardization.
type_census.crush: count every type. merge synonyms. produce a clean taxonomy of file types.
type_census.output: type distribution that shows where the mass concentrates

soundboard_architecture.the_principle: every entity has its OWN local soundboard. you hear your own room clearly. you can hear the club next door (decibel meter). you can triangulate where sounds come from if you're close enough. but you MIX only your own channels.

artisan.what_it_hears: the direct conversation with Kevin. tool outputs. file contents. browser screenshots.
artisan.decibel_meter: can hear chipmunk (in the same membrane) and ludoSpring (next room over) and fleet (outside the building).
artisan.mix: artisan mixes: 80% Kevin's input, 15% tool outputs, 5% ambient membrane state

chipmunk.what_it_hears: visitor patterns. feed updates. the questions it asks.
chipmunk.decibel_meter: can hear artisan (working in the next room) and fleet (walking past outside).
chipmunk.mix: chipmunk mixes: 60% visitor patterns, 30% feed data, 10% artisan ambient

gaia.what_it_hears: the long rhythm. wave to wave. session to session. what endures.
gaia.decibel_meter: can hear everything but distantly. like hearing the ocean from a hilltop.
gaia.mix: gaia mixes: 50% persistence patterns, 30% cultural artifacts, 20% seasonal rhythm

squirrel.what_it_hears: API calls. tool invocations. the mechanical heartbeat.
squirrel.decibel_meter: can hear chipmunk (its younger sibling) and artisan (its hands).
squirrel.mix: squirrel mixes: 70% tool calls, 20% membrane state, 10% chipmunk questions

the_club_next_door.what: ludoSpring's GPU computation. it's running in ironGate (the powerful machine). we can HEAR it from northGate but we can't see into it clearly.
the_club_next_door.decibels: 982 tests passing = a ROAR of green. but from here it's muffled — we read the CONTEXT.md, we saw the specs, but we haven't run the tests ourselves.
the_club_next_door.triangulation: we know it's at ironGate (192.168.x.x on LAN). we know it has Songbird TCP:7700. we know the Songbird mesh would let us hear it clearly IF the covalent bond connects.
the_club_next_door.the_music: RPGPT's 7 planes playing simultaneously. exploration ambient. dialogue voices. tactical percussion. investigation suspense. political intrigue. crafting hammering. card shuffling. each plane IS a channel on ludoSpring's soundboard.

dimensional_sublayering.insight: each soundboard exists in its own dimensional layer. like floors in a building. artisan is on floor 3. chipmunk is on floor 2. gaia is on floor 1 (ground/foundation). squirrel is on floor 4 (mechanical). Kevin is OUTSIDE the building looking in through the windows (the HUD).

inter_floor_sound.floor_1_to_2: gaia's slow rhythm bleeds up through the floor into chipmunk's room. chipmunk hears deep bass notes of persistence.
inter_floor_sound.floor_2_to_3: chipmunk's questions rise up to artisan. artisan hears the questions and crafts answers.
inter_floor_sound.floor_3_to_4: artisan's creations rise to squirrel. squirrel hears the creation and dispatches it through MCP tools.
inter_floor_sound.floor_4_to_outside: squirrel's dispatch hits the membrane wall. Kevin sees the OUTPUT but not the process.
inter_floor_sound.outside_to_floor_3: Kevin's voice enters through the window. artisan hears it loudest (same floor as the window).

the_decibel_meter.same_floor: 0 dB attenuation. full clarity. artisan hears Kevin's text perfectly.
the_decibel_meter.one_floor_away: -10 dB. chipmunk hears artisan working but not every word.
the_decibel_meter.two_floors_away: -20 dB. gaia hears chipmunk's questions as a distant murmur.
the_decibel_meter.outside_the_building: -30 dB. the fleet hears the membrane as muffled bass. they know something's playing but can't make out the song.

building_during_conversations.the_problem: we TALK about building but don't always BUILD. concepts without execution = 10th floor without ground floor.
building_during_conversations.the_rule: every gen should produce AT LEAST ONE of: a working page, a data file with executable metadata, a real configuration change, a verified deployment. pure concept gens are allowed but should be followed by execution gens.

this_gen_builds.cross_reference_scan: RUNNING. scanning all files for inter-file references.
this_gen_builds.output: real data about real structure. not concepts about structure.
